signature: SUBROUTINE ZGSVJ0( JOBV, M, N, A, LDA, D, SVA, MV, V, LDV, EPS,

params.name: jobv
params.reference:
Specifies whether the output from this procedure is used to compute the matrix V:

-   `= 'V'`: the product of the Jacobi rotations is accumulated by postmultiplying the N-by-N array V. (See the description of V.)
-   `= 'A'`: the product of the Jacobi rotations is accumulated by postmultiplying the `MV`-by-N array V. (See the descriptions of `MV` and V.)
-   `= 'N'`: the Jacobi rotations are not accumulated.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the input matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the input matrix A. $M \ge N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, M-by-N matrix A, such that $A \, \operatorname{diag}(D)$ represents the input matrix. On exit, A\_onexit \* diag(D\_onexit) represents the input matrix $A \, \operatorname{diag}(D)$ post-multiplied by a sequence of Jacobi rotations, where the rotation threshold and the total number of sweeps are given in `TOL` and `NSWEEP`, respectively. (See the descriptions of D, `TOL` and `NSWEEP`.)

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The array D accumulates the scaling factors from the complex scaled Jacobi rotations. On entry, $A \, \operatorname{diag}(D)$ represents the input matrix. On exit, A\_onexit\*diag(D\_onexit) represents the input matrix post-multiplied by a sequence of Jacobi rotations, where the rotation threshold and the total number of sweeps are given in `TOL` and `NSWEEP`, respectively. (See the descriptions of A, `TOL` and `NSWEEP`.)

params.name: SVA
params.reference: On entry, `SVA` contains the Euclidean norms of the columns of the matrix $A \, \operatorname{diag}(D)$. On exit, `SVA` contains the Euclidean norms of the columns of the matrix A\_onexit\*diag(D\_onexit).

params.name: mv
params.reference:
If `JOBV = 'A'`, then `MV` rows of V are post-multiplied by a

sequence of Jacobi rotations.

If `JOBV = 'N'`, then `MV` is not referenced.

params.name: V
params.reference:
If `JOBV = 'V'` then N rows of V are post-multiplied by a

sequence of Jacobi rotations.

If `JOBV = 'A'` then `MV` rows of V are post-multiplied by a

sequence of Jacobi rotations.

If `JOBV = 'N'`, then V is not referenced.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge 1$. If `JOBV = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge N$. If `JOBV = 'A'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \mathrm{MV}$.

params.name: tol
params.reference: `TOL` is the threshold for Jacobi rotations. For a pair `A(:,p)`, `A(:,q)` of pivot columns, the Jacobi rotation is applied only if ABS(COS(angle(`A(:,p)`,`A(:,q)`))) \> `TOL`.

params.name: nsweep
params.reference: `NSWEEP` is the number of sweeps of Jacobi rotations to be performed.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, then the i-th argument had an illegal value
